## Target

Identify the model family/checkpoint format, hardware platform and intended stages.
Link public upstream architecture documentation if available.

## Current capability

Include the registry/preflight result and any native Dense inference evidence.
Separate registered metadata, environment readiness and measured quality.

## Proposed work and validation

Describe missing contracts, isolated dependencies, available calibration/evaluation
inputs and how model-specific Dense baselines will be established. See the model
migration guide before proposing reuse of another model's recipes or measurements.
